raw_content: {"skill_adoption": [], "extracted_pattern": "The agent correctly identified Mounier-Kuhn Syndrome by relying on direct visual evidence from CT images (Figures 4-6) which showed pathognomonic tracheobronchomegaly and diverticula, despite the CXR tools (classifier and report generator) failing to detect these specific structural abnormalities or returning non-specific/negative findings.
